iflow.configuration.nodePath.description: Custom Node.js executable used to spawn the CLI
iflow.configuration.warmStart.descriptio: Start the iFlow CLI in the background when the window opens, so the chat panel is ready instantly on first open (uses ~100MB memory per window)
iflow.configuration.soundFeedback.descri: Play a short sound when a turn completes or fails
iflow.configuration.restoreLastSession.d: Restore the last used session when the panel starts, instead of opening a fresh session (falls back to a new session when nothing is restorable)
iflow.configuration.autoOpenPanel.descri: Open the chat panel automatically when VSCode starts
iflow.configuration.language.description: iFlow CLI interface language written to `~/.iflow/settings.json`. Empty = leave the CLI's own value untouched. Takes effect after a CLI restart.
iflow.configuration.approvalMode.descrip: Default approval mode written to ~/.iflow/settings.json (default = ask for confirmation, smart = auto-approve safe edits, yolo = auto-approve everything, plan = read-only planning). Empty = leave the CLI's own value untouched. Takes effect after a CLI restart.
iflow.configuration.osNotifications.desc: Show OS notifications when the panel is not visible: 'approvals' = only when a tool approval / question / plan blocks the agent; 'all' = also on long tool completions and finished turns; 'off' = never.
iflow.configuration.contextWindowOverrid: Model context-window overrides, one per line as `model=tokenCount` (e.g. `glm-4.6=200000`). Overrides the built-in table; unknown models fall back to a conservative default.
iflow.configuration.costTable.descriptio: Unit prices for the session cost estimate, one per line as `model=inputPrice,outputPrice` in USD per million tokens (e.g. `deepseek-v3=0.27,1.1`).
iflow.configuration.autoTitle.descriptio: After a session's first turn, generate a short AI title for it in the session switcher (one extra lightweight model call per session).
iflow.configuration.checkpoints.descript: Snapshot the workspace into a private shadow git repo before each turn so file changes can be rolled back per turn. The user's own .git is never touched; non-git folders work too.
iflow.configuration.checkpointMaxFiles.d: Disable workspace snapshots for a session when its file count exceeds this cap (guards against very large workspaces).
Skip files larger than this size (MB) when snapshotting the workspace — their changes are excluded from rollback and the shadow repo stays small. Shared by every turn, so one huge file does not multiply storage. 0 = no size limit.
iflow.configuration.checkpointDir.descri: Custom root directory for turn-level snapshot stores (supports ~ and workspace-relative paths). Each workspace gets its own subfolder under this root. Leave empty to use the default workspaceStorage location.
iflow.configuration.checkpointMaxTurns.d: Keep at most this many snapshots per session; older snapshots are pruned after each turn. 0 = no limit.
Global cap for all snapshot stores in MB; when exceeded the least-recently-used session stores are deleted whole (orphaned/corrupt stores are always reclaimed). 0 = no limit.
